teaser.en: Its flowers hang in long strings of pink and white puffs that open at dusk and lie scattered on the water by morning.
teaser.sw: Maua yake huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu ya vishada vya waridi na vyeupe vinavyochanua jioni, na kufikia asubuhi huwa yametapakaa juu ya maji.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganabwadzika dza kamba nyire za mafungu ga rangi ya pinki na nyereru, ganayovugula dziloni, na kuchicha ganakala ganalala hiku na hiku dzulu ya madzi.

summary.en: *Mworong'ondo*, the powder-puff tree or freshwater mangrove, is a small tree of stream banks and brackish back-swamps. Its long hanging chains of flowers make it one of the prettiest trees of the coastal wetlands.
summary.sw: *Mworong'ondo*, au mtomondo kwa Kiswahili, ni mti mdogo wa kingo za vijito na mabwawa ya maji ya chumvi kidogo yaliyo nyuma ya mikoko. Mishororo yake mirefu ya maua yanayoning'inia huufanya kuwa mojawapo ya miti mizuri zaidi ya maeneo oevu ya pwani.
summary.dg: *Mworong'ondo* (kpwa Chingereza *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*) ni muhi mdide wa kanda-kanda ya miho midide na tsi za matope za madzi ga munyu chidide nyuma ya mikoko. Kpwa sababu ya maruwage ganayobwadzika dza kamba nyire, ni kahi ya mihi minono sana ya tsi za madzi za pwani.

about.en:
*Mworong'ondo* is a small tree with large, glossy leaves clustered towards the ends of the branches. Its flowers hang in long strings, sometimes longer than an arm, each flower a soft puff of pink and white stamens.

The flowers open in the evening and drop by the next morning, so the ground or the water beneath is often dotted with fallen puffs. They are followed by four-angled fruits, which hang in the same long strings and can float away on the water.
about.sw:
*Mworong'ondo* ni mti mdogo wenye majani makubwa yanayong'aa, yaliyojikusanya kuelekea ncha za matawi. Maua yake huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu, wakati mwingine mirefu kuliko mkono, na kila ua ni kishada laini cha stamini za waridi na nyeupe.

Maua huchanua jioni na kupukutika kufikia asubuhi inayofuata, hivyo ardhi au maji yaliyo chini mara nyingi huwa yametapakaa vishada vilivyoanguka. Hufuatwa na matunda yenye pembe nne, ambayo huning'inia katika mishororo mirefu ileile na yanaweza kuelea na kuchukuliwa na maji.
about.dg:
*Mworong'ondo* ni muhi mdide wenye makodza makulu ganayoala, ganayokala phamwenga kanda ya ntsa za pandaze. Maruwage ganabwadzika dza kamba nyire, wakati wanjina nyire kuriko mkpwono wa mutu, na chila ruwa ni fungu laini ra nyuzi za rangi ya pinki na nyereru.

Maruwa ganavugula dziloni na kuchicha ganakala gakagbwa, kpwa hivyo tsi au madzi ga photsi kpwa kawaida gana maruwa manji garigogbwa. Badaye kunatuluka matunda genye pembe nne, ganayobwadzika dza kamba nyire dza maruwa, na ganaweza kuelea na kutsukulwa ni madzi.

where.en: Look for it on stream banks and in the brackish back-swamps of the coastal strip, where fresh water from the land meets the reach of the tide. It is a tree of the quiet water behind the mangroves rather than of the open sea.
where.sw: Utaupata kwenye kingo za vijito na katika mabwawa ya maji ya chumvi kidogo ya ukanda wa pwani, ambapo maji baridi kutoka bara yanakutana na kufikiwa na maji kujaa. Ni mti wa maji tulivu yaliyo nyuma ya mikoko badala ya bahari iliyo wazi.
where.dg: Uhendze kanda-kanda ya miho midide na kahi ya tsi za matope za madzi ga munyu chidide za pwani, ambapho madzi gasigo na munyu kula bara ganakutana na madzi ga kuodzala. Ni muhi wa madzi ganayotulia nyuma ya mikoko, si wa bahari kulu.

uses.en: No particular uses have been recorded among the Digo so far.
uses.sw: Hadi sasa hakuna matumizi maalumu yaliyorekodiwa miongoni mwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Hadi sambi takuna kazi iriyoandikpwa ya muhi uhu kahi ya Adigo.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mworong'ondo*, also written *muorong'ondo*. In Swahili it is *mtomondo*. In English it is the powder-puff tree or freshwater mangrove, and its scientific name is *Barringtonia racemosa*.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo *mworong'ondo*, pia huandikwa *muorong'ondo*. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *mtomondo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Barringtonia racemosa*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mworong'ondo*, na piya rinaandikpwa *muorong'ondo*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mtomondo*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *powder-puff tree* au *freshwater mangrove*, na dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Barringtonia racemosa*.
